files.extent_note: Single HTML page (no PDF offered). Section headings 6.1-6.11 all present with contiguous top-level numbering; running prose through every section; chapter-information section and '6.11 References' (~34 entries, alphabetical) present; page continues into the site footer, no truncation. The chapter's 41 formula/figure images (cochrane.org /sites/default/files/uploads/media/images/) were downloaded into images/ (listed as separate files) so the formulas are held; the saved HTML references them by site-absolute path. Section 6.7.2 continues past 'Such data may be included in meta-analyses only' into 6.7.2.1 and sections 6.8-6.11 (the earlier WebFetch truncation was a tool artefact).
